datasets.purpose: IPC Classification spatial data in different IPC scenarios collected by FEWS NET enumerators on a regular schedule (typically monthly).

lineage.description: FEWS NET enumerators conducted regular (typically monthly) field assessments across Malawi to classify acute food insecurity conditions using the IPC framework. Geographic boundaries were mapped and classified into IPC phases (1-5) representing severity levels from minimal to catastrophic food insecurity, with projections generated for multiple scenarios to support early warning and humanitarian response planning.
